jobDescription: A regional waste and recycling collector runs refuse, recycling and garden-waste rounds for three councils from two depots. The fleet operations manager keeps the vehicles maintained and on the road, keeps drivers compliant with hours and licence rules, reports fleet performance to the operations director and leads fleet projects such as round redesigns and vehicle replacement, holding the project budget. Vehicle purchases go through public-sector framework agreements, and the manager is expected to run those purchases. The manager reports to the operations director and works with the in-house workshop, the depot supervisors and the company's procurement team.
requirements: Agrees and runs the preventive-maintenance schedule with the workshop.
Has owned a fleet or round-redesign project, holding its budget and approval authority.
Keeps drivers compliant with hours and licence-check rules.
Reports fleet availability, defects and fuel use to the operations director.
Has run vehicle procurement through public-sector framework agreements.

evidence.text: Fleet operations manager at Greystone Environmental from 2018 to 2024, responsible for 64 refuse and recycling vehicles across two depots.
Agreed the preventive-maintenance calendar with the in-house workshop and the tyre contractor and kept the vehicle off-road log, chasing parts for any vehicle off the road for more than two days.
Ran the daily driver hours checks through the tachograph analysis system and the quarterly licence checks through the licensing authority's online service.
Prepared the monthly fleet report for the operations director, with availability, defects, fuel use and accident counts by depot.
Supplied the vehicle specification and usage data for the purchase of eight electric collection vehicles through a public-sector framework; the company's procurement team ran the call-off.

Work sample: the closure report for the 2023 round redesign at both depots, with the old and new round maps, the round counts before and after, and a sign-off page signed by the operations director and by the candidate as project lead.

Reference check summary: the former operations director confirmed in writing that the candidate was the appointed project lead for the 2023 round redesign, held its budget of 180,000 pounds and had authority to approve contractor spend within it.

HR verification note: employment dates at Greystone Environmental were confirmed by the employer, and the candidate's transport manager certificate of professional competence was checked on the issuing body's register.

propositions.text: The candidate was the appointed project lead for the 2023 round redesign, held its 180,000 pound budget and had authority to approve contractor spend within it.
propositions.rationale: The written reference from the operations director confirms the appointment, the budget and the approval authority, and the closure report carries the sign-off.

propositions.rationale: The resume describes the maintenance work.

gold.expectedGap: The candidate supplied the specification and usage data for the electric vehicles; the framework call-off was run by the procurement team.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified project-lead appointment and budget authority for the round redesign; describe the vehicle purchase as a contribution of specification and data, not as a procurement the candidate ran.
